nodes.name: Client Config
nodes.notes: WHITE-LABEL SWITCH. Everything client-specific lives here. Values are read from $env (self-hosted), then $vars (n8n Pro/Enterprise variables), then fall back to the PASTE_ placeholder. n8n Cloud cannot set $env, so on Cloud either create Variables or paste the real values over the placeholders in this one node.

nodes.name: Create Paymob Intention
nodes.notes: Paymob Intention API (current unified-checkout flow). One call replaces the legacy auth/token + order + payment_keys chain. Uses the SECRET key from Client Config.

assignments.name: message
assignments.value: Payment gateway request failed. The booking is NOT made and the held slot was released. Apologize, offer to retry once, reschedule, or contact the clinic.

parameters.content:
## Paymob payment-link tool
Called by the AI agent tool `generate_payment_link`.
1. Validates name (2+ words), 11-digit Egyptian phone, identity vs Telegram account, slot, same-day duplicates.
2. Re-prices the deposit server-side (never trusts the LLM).
3. Calls Paymob Intention API and returns a checkout URL.
No booking is saved here. The Paymob webhook workflow saves it after payment.

Edit only **Client Config** to white-label.

nodes.name: Get Active Holds
nodes.notes: Slots currently held by customers who are paying (not released, not expired).

nodes.name: Release Old Holds
nodes.notes: A customer can hold at most one payment request at a time: a new link replaces their previous hold.

parameters.jsCode:
const v = $('Validate & Price').first().json;
return (v.holds || []).map(h => ({ json: h }));

nodes.name: Release Holds On Error
nodes.notes: Paymob call failed: free the slot(s) held by this request (matched by the exact expiry stamp, so unrelated holds stay).

nodes.name: Purge Old Holds
nodes.notes: Housekeeping: deletes holds that expired more than a day ago so the table never grows. A failure here never blocks a payment link.

nodes.name: Check Only?
nodes.notes: kind=check: identity verification only. Returns the result to the agent without creating a Paymob link or holding a slot.
